title: iDuoDuo Girls Breathable Hollow Out Princess Mary Jane Flat Shoes Blue 9 M US Toddler
review:
I purchased these as my daughter wanted sandals for school, but I do like opened toe shoes at school (on the playground or an unexpected sports class etc.) So I chose these as an inexpensive alternative, (as kids grow out of shoes yearly) also as an add on item to an additional order. This aside I still wanted them to do the job and be functional cute, summer to fall, then winter into spring school shoes, also possibly be passed down to her sister, so I did shop around and read reviews. Firstly many reviewers said they ran way small (like a whole size), so I ordered a size and a half up, (which was only a half size bigger than her new school tennis shoes) so she could get the school year out of them. Well when they came in she they were way too big! so I don't know if they really run much smaller than expected, I would say they are fairly close to true to size,,,, these now will probably fit her two years! ** Secondly the reason I gave these only one star, (and this is my bad) I read mostly great reviews 4-5 stars only concern was the size. BUT there was one reviewer that gave the only bad review, and that was about the quality, she said they did not even last one day on the playground when her daughter wore them to school, that the shoes came home terribly scuffed on the toes, like the toes actually worn off! Well THIS also happened to us! I should have turned away after reading that one review but I didn't, so I guess it is my fault. My daughter also came home after wearing these shoes for the first time today, and the toes are mostly WHITE !! they are that scuffed. Not just scuffs, but the color completely gone! worn off ! And she swears she did not do anything out of the ordinary, just regular school yard play, and average classroom activities. Knowing my child I believe her, yes she is very active and does run around, swing, climb and crawl thru the tunnels on her school playground, but I've also watched her play and know she is not rough or excessive when she is playing. So my review --- STAY AWAY from these shoes, these are cheap as far as shoes go, so I guess I got what I paid for, but even at almost $17 I thought they world last maybe six months. NOPE, unless you are only looking for a pair to last one day, and during that time your child will not ever be going outdoors of running/crawling/jumping/skipping around any, save your money, spend a little extra on a quality brand, I DO NOT recommend these! These will not make it through the whole school year, I am embarrassed to let her wear them even one more day as they now look so terrible, and these most certainly will not last to be past down to her little sister :( (on any kind of plus side, she still thinks they are pretty, and says we can try to color over them a bit. And even though they are a little bigger than we wanted, she says they are comfortable, if that is any consolation)

title: Ministar Girls Baby Infant Toddler Prewalker Leather Shoes - Rose Puppy - Large 12-18 mo.
review: I bought these (a size large, 12-18 months, 5.5 in) for my then,16.5 month old daughter, who is now 18 months and still wearing them! The sizing is a bit large for the recommended age group but fit true to size based on the listed inches. My daughter is 18 months with a 5-inch length foot and these shoes finally fit her perfectly. They are a tad bit wide, but I feel it gives room for the fit to move freely as needed. They seem to be very comfy to wear and walk in; no complaints from my little one and she doesn't attempt take them off too often. The elastic keeps them in place and prevents them from slipping off. The sole is thin which allows my little one to walk with confidence. It's as close to being barefoot as she can get, which I like. They have been through a month and half of wear and tear from an active toddler (lots of outdoor use in the sun, rain, dirt, everywhere!) and while they did lose their luster quickly (the bottoms are also really dirty), they still work pretty well. If only I could find a good way to clean them, they'd last longer. I will definitely buy another pair when these ones are ready to be retired.

I am absolutely in love with these shoes! The ones that arrived at my place look exactly like the picture and they are gorgeous and extremely comfortable! I can walk in these for quite some time without any problem! I bought them to go with a black skirt I own and they match perfectly with a nice casual outfit. I've had these shoes for about 3 hours now and I've already gotten so many compliments on them! Wonderful product!

These are great shoes to complete an outfit or costume. They look great with Alice in Wonderland themed items or anything in red, black or white. You could probably wear them for a short walk around the mall or something, but the soles are thin, and I wouldn't wear them for a *lot* of walking, or every day. I wear a size 9, and this 9 fits me well enough, but I think I could have used just a bit more room around the toes, and given a choice I would have picked a 9.5. 10 would have been way too big. Just put a year outdoor and indoor (on fluid trainer) on these. These were my first pair of clipless pedals and did not want to pay a lot for something that I had never used and did not know if I would like. The shoes have held up well and are still very comfortable. Pedals on the other hand have not faired so well. Got about 1500 miles on them before they fell apart on a ride. Pedal came off of the spindal...bearings lost. Limped home on the spindal. Had to throw them out and upgrade. As a frugal rider, I hate to say this, but, spend the extra $20 or so and pick up a pair of Shimano clipless pedals

Great set up for the money. Was not sure i wanted to go clipless and for this price was easy to try it out without breaking the bank. Just a few side notes. 1 go, if you can, to a bike shop and get sized. The size charts are not right on here. 2 if you are like me and like to stop and smell the roses as it where while road biking the road shoes may not be your best bet. Hard to walk in but the up side peddles are large enough that you can take a quick spin in any shoe. 3 same people sell a clipless mtb bike shoe with a full peddle so that is something I may pick up in the near future. So in conclusion if your thinking you want clipless and you just ride get these they have held up great so far I do about 100+ miles a week and have had them for about a month so far very happy. Oh also the shoes are usable with both major cleat types just remove the insole and pull the metal plate if you don't have anything in them they slide around and can get loud.

Not the best made shoe available but I think it is the best shoe at the price! Runs true to size, well ventilated (not a winter shoe) and the fit is good. If you are a racer or very particular this may not be for you but for general use it's good. I expect it to last a couple of seasons, if so I got my money's worth.

title: Cari Cuff Silver Hair Tie Bracelet Bangle Ponytail Holder Adjustable w/ Gift Box
review:
Perfect way to hold something I'm always carrying around anyway.

I don't often post reviews on Amazon -- usually only for things that were completely awful or things I absolutely love. This falls into the second category. My daughter wanted a hair tie bracelet for her birthday and there were several different ones on Amazon. The "brand name" one was really expensive so I ruled that out. So I ordered a Cari Cuff and several other cheaper ones as my daughter tends to lose things so I figured having a couple backups wouldn't hurt. I also ordered one from Kohls -- it was more expensive than this one so I figured if the Cari Cuff was ok, I'd just return the Kohl's one to the store. The whole point of this is to say that this is not one of those "I got the product for free in exchange for my glowing review"-type reviews. I purchased this bracelet along with several of its competitors using my own money. And I will say that the Cari Cuff was by far the nicest of all of them. It arrived in a beautiful gift box while the cheaper ones were in cheap plastic bags with barcode stickers on them or in a flimsy velvet drawstring bag with threads hanging out of the seams. The Cari Cuff is sturdy and a nice weight while the cheaper ones were flimsy and easily bent. The hair tie stays on it well while it falls off the cheaper ones all the time. The ends are nicely finished on the Cari Cuff while on the cheaper ones, it is like they were just cut from a long band of metal and not sanded or shaped in any way so they are a bit sharp -- they can scratch both your wrist and your laptop or desk if you lean your wrists against them to type. Comparing the Cari Cuff to the more expensive Kohls bracelet, the Cari Cuff was still the winner - the Kohls one was overly heavy and clunky and had a weird pattern design....and it was HUGE (as in probably would have fit my husband huge). No way would it stay on my daughter's wrist so I ended up returning it. So overall the Cari Cuff is heads and tails above all the others I ordered. And perhaps the best testament to that is the fact that it has not left my daughter's wrist since day 2 (after she spent day 1 trying all the different bracelets) -- anything she manages to not lose or misplace is something she really really loves. (And note: after over a month of constant wearing, the bracelet still looks brand new so the finish is holding up great.) And a maybe even better testament is that while I figured I would just wear the cheaper ones that my daughter rejected, after trying to use them all for the last month and being annoyed that the hair ties keep falling off and my wrist and laptop keep getting scratched by the unfinished ends, I am back here ordering another Cari Cuff for myself. (Happy Mothers Day to Me!) So if you are trying to decide which of the many hair-tie bracelets here on Amazon is the best value, I would definitely recommend this one. It is a little more expensive than some of the other ones on Amazon, but well worth the extra money!
